title: Warm Whipped Filipino Coconut Halo Halo
description: A tangy and fluffy Filipino dessert featuring rose water and caramelized sugar, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, served in a halo halo form.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine coconut milk, rose water, and turbinado sugar, and heat over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar is dissolved.
Increase the heat to medium and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, whip the cooled coconut milk mixture until it becomes fluffy and doubled in volume.
In a small saucepan, caramelize the caramel sauce over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it turns a deep amber color.
To assemble the halo halo, scoop the whipped coconut milk into a glass or bowl, followed by a spoonful of jackfruit, kaong, and pinipig.
Drizzle the caramel sauce over the top and sprinkle with shredded coconut.
Top with a dollop of whipped cream and serve immediately.
